hero_kpi_rationale: RH is a luxury retailer specializing in high-end furnishings and design. Gross margin is the key KPI to assess core business profitability and the ability to maintain premium value amid pricing pressures and supply chain costs.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: What the company earns after paying the cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin declines from 44.5% in 2024 to 44.1% in 2025, primarily due to higher occupancy costs in the RH segment and a slight contraction in core business margins, partially offset by freight cost savings.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in gross margin, driven by occupancy costs and pricing pressure.

kpis.name: Net Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenue earned from product sales, net of returns and discounts.
kpis.description: Consolidated net revenues increase from $3,181M in 2024 to $3,440M in 2025 (+$259M), driven by the RH segment (+8.5%) and a slight increase in Waterworks (+2.7%).
kpis.signal: Strong sales growth in 2025, driven by product transformation and platform expansion.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Profit generated from core operations before taxes and interest.
kpis.description: Operating income increases from $322.6M in 2024 to $387.3M in 2025, supported by sales growth and controlled SG&A expenses.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in operating profitability, indicating strong cost management despite margin pressure.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Profitability measure that excludes non-recurring items to better reflect underlying performance.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA rises from $539.1M in 2024 to $596.5M in 2025, supported by revenue growth and disciplined operational cost control.
kpis.signal: Solid growth in adjusted EBITDA, reflecting underlying operational improvement.

kpis.name: Adjusted CapEx
kpis.explanation: Capital spent to build or acquire assets such as stores or equipment, including leasehold assets.
kpis.description: Adjusted capital expenditures (capital expenditures plus net construction in progress for leasehold assets less tenant allowances) increase from $282.3M in 2024 to $288.9M in 2025.
kpis.signal: Slight increase in adjusted CapEx, reflecting continued investment in physical gallery expansion.

kpis.name: Adjusted Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net profit after taxes, excluding extraordinary gains or losses.
kpis.description: Adjusted net income rebounds to $124.4M in 2025, compared to $107.2M in 2024, following a 2024 charge of $36M in asset impairments related to galleries in Germany.
kpis.signal: Strong increase in adjusted net income, recovery following 2024 asset impairments.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.125B in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Diluted EPS
kpis.description: Diluted EPS extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Diluted EPS of $6.31 in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

risks.title: Consumer demand variability
risks.score_rationale: The risk is listed first and described as potentially "significantly affecting our revenues and results." The language is strong and recurring, with central importance in results analysis. The Macro category is highly weighted.

risks.title: Pressure on gross margin
risks.score_rationale: Multiple paragraphs detail cost pressures (raw materials, logistics, tariffs). Explicit mention of recent increases in cost of goods sold. Recurring risk intensified by commercial policy.

risks.title: Significant asset impairments
risks.score_rationale: Material amounts recorded ($36M in 2025), related to galleries under construction and long-lived assets in Germany. Language suggests strategic missteps or delays. Recurring risk but expected to decline in 2026.

risks.title: Costly product recalls
risks.score_rationale: Direct costs mentioned ($1.9M in 2025) and impact on customer trust. The recall is cited as a notable event in 2025. Reputation category heavily impacted.

risks.title: Global expansion and foreign exchange risk
risks.score_rationale: Growing exposure to foreign currencies with global expansion. Cautious language: "not currently exposed to significant risk" but future risk anticipated. Moderate positioning in the text.

risks.title: Significant quarterly fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly named and tied to operational planning (launches, Sourcebooks). Descriptive but not alarming language. Annual repetition indicates risk stability.

risks.title: Rising operating costs
risks.score_rationale: SG&A increases linked to store openings, marketing, and exceptional costs. Recurring mention in financial statements. Less critical than margin pressure but structural.

ai_positioning.summary: RH does not mention any strategy, technology, or initiative related to artificial intelligence in the provided documents. The company focuses on product transformation, platform expansion, design, and luxury real estate.
evidence: No mention of AI, APIs, chatbots, or AI-driven automation in the Business, MD&A, or Risk sections.
Cloud computing investments are noted but related to IT cost amortization, not AI capabilities.
No references to partnerships, products, or deals involving AI functionalities.
